packageRules.description: The otel log packages are pinned via `replace` directives written by the Dagger SDK codegen. github.com/dagger/otel-go uses log.KeyValue and log.Value, which v0.22.0 removed, so bumping these breaks every module. Renovate cannot tell a deliberate pin from a stale one. See #27.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in Dagger module Go code, annotated with `// renovate:` above a `// +default="..."` or a `const ... = "..."` (e.g. terraform/main.go, terraform/container.go)
